metric_definitions.step: max across ranks of per-rank mean of 20 steps; excludes zero_grad
metric_definitions.std: sample standard deviation across three independent runs
metric_definitions.sync: max across ranks of mean time inside synchronize_gradient; for overlap this measures residual waiting and averaging only, excluding launches and communication during backward
metric_definitions.sync_fraction: post-backward synchronization fraction; NOT total communication fraction for overlap

correctness.source: preceding turn actual WSL pytest execution

limitations: CPU small model, not multi-GPU XL
Only 3 repeats per version, fixed order, host load uncontrolled
No per-step samples or communication timeline
Benchmark completion is not a numerical equivalence test
